packageRules.description: bits-ui v2 is a major breaking change but bits-ui is only a transitive dep via layerchart@2.0.0-next which pins it to v1. Bumping breaks the chart components.
TypeScript v6 is too new — keep on v5 until svelte-check / sveltekit ecosystem is fully validated against it.
Group SvelteKit + vite + vite-plugin-svelte updates together. They have peer-dep constraints on each other and updating them in one PR avoids the chicken-and-egg failures we hit before.
